stash_use.detail: Its premise, distinct ids among the ops the log is rebuilt from, follows from SHA-256 having no collision on them (Vacuity.Draft.back, via distinct_of_collisionFree). App.St holds IO handles, so no concrete St is built in the kernel; the headless host program checks the conclusion on the running app: a draft survives the switcher and back.

draftIn_newest.detail: The app's ephemeral log as it starts (empty), one entry, the text "half a thought", no photos, generation 1, through the running node family: the log is rebuilt from that one draft op, and the entry's draft read from it is exactly that op's.

draftIn_empty.detail: An empty composer on the empty log: the log is rebuilt from no op, and no draft is read for the entry.

write_ephemeral.detail: A concrete draft op, "half a thought" for one entry, in Community's family with the running crypto (Data.C). No hypotheses.

write_valid.detail: The same draft op is Valid with its fields. No hypotheses.
